metadata.title: Growth Through the Microsoft Alliance: Pax8’s Kristen Fehrenbach and New Charter’s Michelle Curtis, Live from Pax8 Beyond 2026

content.text:
Growth Through the Microsoft Alliance: Pax8’s Kristen Fehrenbach and New Charter’s Michelle Curtis, Live from Pax8 Beyond 2026
Watch Video Highlights Below, or Click HERE:
Tech Edge hosted a fireside chat on June 9 at Pax8 Beyond 2026 in Salt Lake City with Kristen Fehrenbach, Vice President of Global Microsoft Alliance at Pax8, and Michelle Curtis, Chief Revenue Officer at New Charter Technologies . The in-person interview was joined by Editor-at-Large Jarrett Banks and they discussed how MSPs can capitalize on Microsoft AI opportunities, especially Copilot and agent-based services, and leverage Pax8's support and deployment expertise to adopt AI solutions. They also explained how Pax8 and Microsoft are working together on product development, including the recent Agent 365 multi-tenancy capabilities and expanded security offerings for Microsoft Business Premium customers.
Never Miss our Weekly Highlights HERE
About Kristen Fehrenbach
Kristen is currently serving as the VP of Microsoft Global Alliance at Pax8, where she designs and leads global strategies that accelerate partner success and drive digital transformation at scale. With over a decade in the technology industry, Kristen is known for translating complex programs into clear, actionable go-to-market strategies that empower partners, vendors, and internal teams to execute and grow together. Her work focuses on building future-ready solutions through AI-powered platforms like the Pax8 Marketplace and shaping how Pax8 shows up with Microsoft across global markets.
About Michelle Curtis
Michelle Curtis is Chief Revenue Officer at New Charter Technologies, where she oversees all revenue functions and leads the company's go-to-market strategy across SMB, mid-market, and enterprise clients. She is focused on strengthening national sales execution, expanding consulting and advanced services adoption, and ensuring a consistent, high-value client experience across New Charter's platform and local teams. In her role, Curtis is helping build a modern, scalable revenue organization while deepening customer engagement and driving growth across the business. She is particularly focused on delivering a people-first, trust-driven approach that brings innovative technology solutions closer to customers, especially small and mid-sized businesses navigating increasing complexity.

About New Charter
At New Charter Technologies, we offer personalized local IT support backed by a nationwide team. With over 50 locations across North America, our extensive resources and deep expertise in cybersecurity, IT consulting, project work, and more, are ready to scale with you.
